findings.reason: the deliverable must state that the lift-presence verdict is resolved before the freshness early-return, or read from the group allowance the candidate already carries (`snapshot.py:1578`, `group_allowance.get("lift")`, available regardless of freshness), because a literal build at the named site fails its own case 5.
findings.text: §54 deliverable bullet 2 locates the lift-presence signal in `_budget_exclusion_reasons` ("the resolved block carries `lift_id`"), but that function returns `[], False` at its freshness gate (`if not fresh: return [], False`, `reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1163`), and `fresh` is False whenever the lane's headroom is unknown (`fresh = reading_known and not state.get("expired")`, `snapshot.py:1540`, where `reading_known` requires `state["headroom"] == "known"`, set only from a numeric utilisation, `reckon/budget.py:1448`) — so under "no window published at all" the flag stays False and `_reserved_lane_exclusion` takes its window term at `snapshot.py:1231` and withholds the lane as unknown, the opposite of done-when case 5 ("a hardest-tier node is offered codex"), while case 6 (same no-window state, no covering lift) needs that very False.

rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the gate logs go under the run directory, each starting with its revision and the literal command and ending in `EXIT=`.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test filename and the symbols §54 names are mechanism terms, carrying no plan label, stage name or ticket number.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §54's "any lift governs" signal is placed inside `_budget_exclusion_reasons`, behind that function's freshness early-return, so it reads False exactly in the no-window case its done-when case 5 asserts is offered.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — both clauses serve one goal, the reserved-lane window term: its reading source and its release condition share one code path and one test file.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §54 declares no depends-on of its own, §53's edge on it (snapshot line 22, `"s53":["lane-and-model-routing#s54"]`) fixes the shared `reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py` write order, and §47, whose credits-lift release §54 extends, is landed.
